bullets: • Define directly observable user-perceived values, not calculation methods.
• Specify single, independent verifiable outcome per criterion; avoid compound conditions.
• State what appears when data is absent or incomplete.
• Clarify tie-breaking or equality rules explicitly for ranked displays.
• Exclude sorting algorithms, data aggregation logic, system architecture.
• Require measurable, testable assertions about visible content only.
• Distinguish edge cases: zero values, empty states, boundary conditions.
• Specify displayed values; omit internal representation or format assumptions.
